name: Teamwork
author: Tom Hayes
description: Teamwork.com task timers in the Omarchy bar: start, pause, log and discard timers, see time accounted against your work hours, and get nudged when no timer is running.

barWidget.description: Running Teamwork timer with task, ticking time, today and week totals against work hours, task list, and a nag when nothing is timing.

schema.label: Teamwork site URL
schema.description: Your Teamwork address, https://<yours>.teamwork.com (https only, no path). The API key is set in the widget's own settings and kept in the keyring.

schema.label: Work days
schema.description: ISO weekday numbers, comma separated: 1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday.

schema.label: Nag when no timer is running
schema.description: During work hours, outside lunch, send a notification when no timer is running.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often timers and time logged are fetched from Teamwork in the background (15 to 3600). 0 turns background polling off: it then refreshes only when the panel opens and after an action, and reminders rely on the last refresh.

schema.label: Warn when a timer runs longer than (hours)
Warn about timers running at lunch or after hours
Sort by custom field
schema.description: Name of a Teamwork task custom field (any case). Its value shows as a badge on each task, and tasks whose value starts with a number sort first, lowest first. Empty turns it off.
